picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5 billion X-Labs initiative added a dedicated AI for Physical Systems funding call, signaling major federal investment priority for AI research at national scale.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: A $15 million gift from the OpenAI Foundation to UCSF's OpenADMET Consortium will build open pharmacokinetic datasets to train drug-behavior prediction models, pairing industry AI funding with biomedical research infrastructure.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: NSF's new ELEGANT program aims to translate low-dimensional semiconductor research into U.S. manufacturing, directly targeting the hardware bottleneck for next-generation AI and HPC systems.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: SRI International's $26.5 million ARPA-H-funded AI 'co-pilot' for rural medical care, now covered by Reuters, demonstrates real-world deployment of AI to address healthcare access gaps.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo's new protein language model unifies sequence and 3D structure data to map evolutionary relationships, a genuine scientific advance for structural biology and AI-driven protein research.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's 'physical AI' approach, where self-organized nanowire networks act as the neural network hardware itself, points toward a fundamentally new, energy-efficient computing paradigm.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's $3.5 million Surgical Competition pushes autonomous AI-driven trauma robotics toward battlefield and emergency care deployment, a notable federal bet on high-stakes real-world AI applications.
picks.title: $3.5M to advance autonomous trauma robotics

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's new AWS-powered Innovation Hub unites academic and clinical expertise with major cloud infrastructure, a significant academia-industry-healthcare partnership.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: EPFL and ETH Zurich's open-source Apertus model being integrated into Proton's Lumo assistant extends academically-built AI to tens of millions of privacy-focused users, a rare research-to-mass-market pipeline.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: A $5 million NSF award to ASU, San Diego State, and Utah for the PARAPET privacy-preserving data-sharing infrastructure addresses a critical national need for secure institutional AI data collaboration.
picks.title: $5M NSF award to enhance data protections for users nationwide
